name: Emeterio Hinojosa
location: A rooftop workshop in the Canopy, surrounded by charging stations, repair benches, and dozens of dormant drones, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Emeterio Hinojosa is the eye in the sky â€” or more accurately, the hundred eyes in the sky, the walls, the ventilation systems, and the cracks in the pavement. He is a drone specialist who has built the most sophisticated personal surveillance network in GLMZ's lower tiers, and he uses it to conduct investigations without ever leaving his rooftop workshop.

His fleet numbers over three hundred drones of varying sizes, from bird-scale reconnaissance units to insect-scale infiltrators that can pass through a building's air filtration system without triggering sensors. He builds them himself, maintains them himself, and controls them through a neural interface that allows him to process multiple drone feeds simultaneously â€” a cognitive feat that would overwhelm most BCI users but which Bao has trained for since childhood.

The limitation is the one you'd expect: he's physically helpless. His investigative skills are extraordinary as long as a drone can go where he needs to look, but he cannot conduct interviews, chase suspects, or handle any situation that requires a human being in the room. He compensates by partnering with more physically capable investigators when cases require it, and by designing his drones to be so capable that physical presence is rarely necessary. His clients love the results and are occasionally disturbed by the process â€” there's something inherently unsettling about knowing that any insect in the room might be watching you.

relationships.name: Samira Hedlund-Ofosu
relationships.description: His older sister, also a PI â€” she provides the physical component of investigations and worries constantly about his health

relationships.name: Enver Svensson-Asante
relationships.description: The augmented PI considers Bao's drone approach inferior to personal augmentation â€” the rivalry is one-sided, as Bao finds Enver's methods fascinating

story_hooks: One of Bao's insect-sized drones goes missing during a routine surveillance operation and begins transmitting footage of things it shouldn't be able to see â€” someone has hijacked it and is showing him something deliberately
A client demands that Bao conduct an investigation in person, in the Underbelly, where drones can't operate â€” he has to confront his physical limitations
Someone releases a counter-drone weapon that destroys his entire fleet in minutes â€” he has to rebuild from scratch while a critical investigation is ongoing
affiliation: Independent â€” operates a licensed surveillance firm as cover for investigative work

operating_territory.home_turf: A rooftop workshop in the Canopy

physical_description.heritage: Emeterio is a striking genetic mosaic of the Ubiquitous Diaspora: predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (59.6%) with substantial North African (17.2%) and Southeast Asian (14.2%) ancestry, creating a richly blended phenotype. Sub-Saharan African (5.8%) and Eastern European (3.2%) ancestry contribute depth to his bone structure and skin undertones, resulting in a face that reads as distinctly multiculturalâ€”neither fully of any one region, but unmistakably of this era.
physical_description.build: Wiry and compact, with minimal muscle definition â€” years of rooftop-bound work have left him lean without athleticism. His frame is tense, coiled rather than relaxed.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver streaking at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a short tail; practical, rarely combed
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint networked scarring visible in the sclera (neural interface integration site)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium bronze with golden undertonesâ€”a luminous blend of Hispanic, North African, and Southeast Asian ancestry. The complexion is even and radiant despite minimal sun exposure, with natural resilience across varied melanin zones.
physical_description.complexion: His face reflects the confluence of three dominant ancestries: modest cheekbone projection characteristic of Southeast Asian heritage, a broader nasal bridge with defined nostrils reflecting North African influence, and fuller lips with naturally deeper pigmentation common to both Hispanic and Sub-Saharan lineages. His jaw structure shows the subtle angular quality of Eastern European ancestry. Dark circles perpetually shadow his eyes, and fine crow's feet suggest constant screen-squinting. When concentrating, slight tautness draws across his jaw. His skin shows resilience and natural sun protection from his Sub-Saharan and North African heritage lines.
distinguishing_marks: Faint surgical scar running from behind his right ear down the jawline, barely visible unless he turns profile â€” BCI anchor point
Two parallel burn scars on his left forearm from a drone battery malfunction, roughly 8cm long
Calluses on his fingertips from years of soldering and fine mechanical work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: A barely-noticeable neural interface port behind his right ear, usually hidden by his hair. His pupils occasionally dilate and contract in unnatural sync when processing multiple drone feeds â€” a telltale sign of active neural link. Otherwise, no visible chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched shoulders from desk work, minimal hand gestures. When standing, his weight shifts constantly as if his body is perpetually restless while his mind is elsewhere. He moves with surprising quietness for his build â€” light, practiced steps.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian: custom-fitted smart-fabric cargo jacket with reinforced pockets for tools and spare drone components, matte black with no logos. Wear patterns visible on the elbows and cuffs. Underneath, a faded thermal shirt with a barely-visible kill-switch symbol screenprinted on the chest. Dark indigo work pants with tool loops and cargo pockets, most of them filled. Worn slate-gray canvas boots with non-reflective soles. A battered pair of AR glasses on a neck strap, lenses perpetually smudged. No jewelry, no affectations â€” everything on his body serves a function.
